rows.Reason Given: CEO David DeSanto's blog "Open Letter to Our Community, Customers, And Partners" (2026-08-14) states "Anaconda eliminated approximately 14% of roles across all functions of the company" and attributes it partly to AI: "the efficiencies AI provides us are real, and not just in Engineering." Restructuring shifts focus to AI software supply chain security and AI agents; company also cited organizational overlap (mixed rationale).

Official company statement to Calcalist: "Pentera is preparing for the rapid changes taking place in the market against the backdrop of the dramatic increase in artificial intelligence capabilities and the adoption of AI-based solutions" and "we are completing the transformation of the company's platform and making it AI-native in order to provide our customers with solutions adapted to the challenges of AI." Unattributed corporate statement to press (no named executive).

PayPal's 10-Q filed 2026-08-31 describes the reorganization as "realigning our operating structure and accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and automation across the company... expected to deliver at least $1.5 billion in gross annualized run-rate savings over the next two to three years." Public statement omitted AI, citing only "simplify our global operations, strengthen execution, and position the company for long-term growth" — attribution rests on the SEC filing.

rows.Name: NVIDIA and Wall Street Giants Form $500B AI Compute Financing Platforms
rows.Description: NVIDIA partnered with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR through memoranda of understanding to establish AI compute infrastructure financing platforms aimed at mobilizing over $500 billion in third-party capital.

rows.Name: xAI Releases Grok 4.6
rows.Description: xAI released Grok 4.6 with a 500K-token context window. API pricing is $2/$6 per million input/output tokens, doubling for content above 200K tokens.

rows.Name: DeepSeek V4-Pro Reaches General Availability
rows.Description: DeepSeek's V4-Pro-0813 exited roughly four months of preview to reach general availability, with a focus on agentic tool use and code execution. It supports a 1M-token context window and up to 384K max output tokens.

rows.Name: Stripe Acquires AI Gateway OpenRouter for Over $7B
rows.Description: Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter, an AI model routing and API gateway startup, in a deal valued at more than $7 billion.

rows.Name: US National Archives Issues Guidance on AI and Federal Records
rows.Description: NARA memo AC 11.2026 clarified that AI use alone does not create a federal record, but that AI inputs, outputs, and audit trails can be records subject to disposal only under approved schedules when used in agency decision-making.

rows.Name: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.8-Flash
rows.Description: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Flash, a smaller, cost-effective model in the Qwen3.8 generation, following the flagship Qwen3.8-Max released August 3.

rows.Name: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
rows.Description: Anthropic released flagship coding and knowledge-work models Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, with Mythos 5.1 offered as a trusted-access variant for approved cybersecurity and life-sciences programs. The release included a 75% price cut on cache reads and roughly a 60% reduction in cybersecurity-filter false positives.

rows.Name: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber
rows.Description: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash, a 1M-token-context, 64K-output multimodal model tuned for long-horizon coding and agent workloads, alongside Flash Cyber, a restricted variant limited to trusted defenders in the 'Fairwind Program.'

rows.Name: Meta Releases Muse Spark 1.3
rows.Description: Meta released Muse Spark 1.3, an updated version of its Meta Superintelligence Labs model line, edging the company closer to rival frontier models.

rows.Name: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra
rows.Description: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra to approved users on September 3 ahead of general availability on September 4 across ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise, the API, and AWS. The release ships with a restricted tier that rejects certain cybersecurity prompts.

rows.Name: NVIDIA Agrees to Acquire Hugging Face for ~$13B
rows.Description: NVIDIA signed a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for approximately $13 billion, confirming reports from late August that a deal was nearing.

rows.Name: NVIDIA and Microsoft Announce Local AI Agent Tooling at IFA 2026
rows.Description: NVIDIA introduced the PAIR tool and faster local inference for running AI agents on-device, alongside Microsoft, with RTX Spark PCs supporting the tooling set to ship in October.

rows.Name: Mistral AI Raises €3B Series D Led by Samsung at >€21B Valuation
rows.Description: Mistral AI raised a €3 billion Series D led by Samsung, the largest-ever equity round by a European tech company, with Scaleup Europe Fund/EQT and PSG Equity co-leading. The funds will support Mistral's compute buildout.

rows.Name: DeepSeek Releases V4.1 Flash
rows.Description: DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash, a 552B-parameter mixture-of-experts causal encoder-decoder model with native multimodal support. V4 Flash was retired from the API on September 14; peak Flash pricing was cut to $0.30/$1.20 per million tokens, with cache-read costs down 57%.

rows.Name: California Enacts 13-Bill Child AI-Safety Package
rows.Description: Governor Newsom signed a 13-bill package of child AI-safety laws, including 'Adam's Law,' which requires chatbot risk assessments before rollout, sets penalties up to $1 million per child harmed, mandates companion-chatbot safeguards, bans addictive features for users under 16, and expands the state's CSAM statute to cover AI-generated content.

rows.Name: Sakana AI Releases Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2
rows.Description: Sakana AI released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2, cheaper and stronger models aimed at multi-agent orchestration.

rows.Name: Dario Amodei Publishes 'We Must Pace the Frontier'; Anthropic Grants Evaluators Employee-Level Access
rows.Description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a roughly 3,800-word essay arguing that frontier AI labs should deliberately pace capability gains, and Anthropic committed to permanent employee-level system access for third-party evaluators including METR. The essay was publicly endorsed within hours by OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk.

rows.Name: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking
rows.Description: Google released Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking voice models, with Extended Thinking topping the Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Quality Index at 82.6%.

edits.text: Update (2026-09-14): second wave of 6 a.m. termination emails began Sep 14, 2026; Q1 FY27 10-Q (filed ~2026-09-11) expanded the restructuring plan by $700M to ~$2.8B amid AI data-center capex. Press estimates of 7,000-10,000 additional roles are NOT confirmed by Oracle; jobs number unchanged.

Update (2026-08-31): execution under way - 10-Q (filed 2026-08-31) reaffirms the reorganization is accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and automation (~$1.5B savings over 2-3 years); CA WARN confirms 251 San Jose roles effective 2026-10-30, recorded on the Losses tab as an executed event.
